description: Boring, weekly-only Renovate config for this repo.

Watches: npm deps under pulumi/ (minor+patch grouped, majors separate), GitHub Actions versions in .github/workflows/, and the Helm chart pins in kubernetes/helmfile.yaml.gotmpl (native helmfile manager — it reads the repositories and releases, OCI included).
Automerge is disabled everywhere — every update lands as a PR for manual review.
